messages:
anna_ops: Kicking off cross-region cluster bring-up thread. goal: a baseline kubeadm/EKS/AKS quickpass for node pools + base addons + gpu readiness. will run through validation steps and handoff checklist.

mike_infra: SGTM. I can own the EKS/GKE bits. anna, do we have region quotas confirmed?

anna_ops: Checked for us-west-2: vCPU quota ok, 50 GPU quota remaining. APAC still needs quota increase (open ticket to cloud-supp).

sara_gpu: note: for GPUs we need driver bootstrap + nvidia-device-plugin + proper taints/labels. I have a small DaemonSet script ready.

raj_sre: remind everyone: networking is often the blocker. make sure pod CIDR and service CIDR don't overlap with customer VPN ranges. Also annotate subnets for private vs public.

anna_ops: here's the quick commands I'll run for each flavor (copy/paste friendly):
```
# kubeadm (on control plane)
kubeadm init --pod-network-cidr=10.244.0.0/16
# EKS (using eksctl)
eksctl create cluster --name redwood-test --region us-west-2 --nodegroup-name gpu-pool --node-type p4d.24xlarge --nodes-min 0 --nodes-max 10 --with-oidc
# AKS (az cli)
az aks create -g rw-infra -n rw-aks --node-vm-size Standard_ND40rs_v2 --enable-cluster-autoscaler --min-count 0 --max-count 8
```

mike_infra: For EKS make sure IRSA is enabled for the kube-system addons (metrics-server, aws-node) and attach the iamPolicy for EBS if we use gp3.

sara_gpu: GPU bootstrap snippet:
```
# on GPU nodes (daemonset or bootstrap script)
apt-get update && apt-get install -y nvidia-driver-525
kubectl apply -f https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NVIDIA/k8s-device-plugin/main/nvidia-device-plugin.yml
kubectl label node <node> accelerator=nvidia
kubectl taint nodes <node> gpu=true:NoSchedule
```

anna_ops: Base addons (we'll install via helm where possible): coredns, metrics-server, calico/canal, cluster-autoscaler, kube-proxy config, kube-state-metrics. Also cert-manager for TLS.

raj_sre: validation checklist for handoff (minimal):
- control plane reachable from jump host
- kubectl get nodes -> Ready for all nodes
- kubectl get pods -A -> no CrashLoopBackOff in kube-system except maybe csi drivers for a minute
- calico status ok (calico/node ds running)
- metrics-server reporting (kubectl top nodes works)
- GPU nodes show allocatable nvidia.com/gpu
- CNI MTU set to 9001 for ENA instances (if relevant)

mike_infra: Adding cost/spot guidance: prefer burstable or spot for worker pools where tolerable, reserve a small on-demand baseline (eg 1-2 nodes) for control. Use node selectors to keep critical workloads off spot nodes.

anna_ops: I'll run these validation commands and paste outputs to confirm:
```
kubectl get nodes -o wide
kubectl get ds -n kube-system
kubectl top nodes
kubectl describe node <gpu-node> | grep -i allocatable -A2
```

deploy-bot: deploy pipeline started for infra/bootstrap/1764004321 (CI: kubeadm-quickpass) :rocket:

sara_gpu: small gotcha: on EKS with bottlerocket, driver install flow differs (use nvidia-driver-installer daemonset). I can drop the YAML into the cluster.

mike_infra: networking note for GKE/AKS: check regional alias IP ranges and node pool subnet sizes. We had a 20k ip exhaustion once because pods per node default was large.

anna_ops: handoff doc draft (will be pushed to runbooks after this thread):
- cluster metadata (region, cloud, cluster-name, created_by)
- cidr ranges (pod & service)
- node pool names/types, autoscaler config, spot policy
- installed addons + versions + helm values
- GPU readiness steps + driver version
- known quotas/limits + support ticket ids (if any)
- smoke test outputs (kubectl get nodes, top, gpu allocatable)

raj_sre: Once anna posts the smoke outputs I'll run a brief chaos scenario (delete a node, verify autoscaler and workload reschedule). want to ensure graceful degradation.

anna_ops: first smoke outputs posted. nodes: 6 total (2 controlplane ki n/a), gpu allocatable visible. metrics-server up. calico pods healthy.

mike_infra: EKS cluster: autoscaler attached, IRSA policies ok. created a nodegroup with mixed instances (a1/g4dn for cost testing).

sara_gpu: I threw the nvidia device plugin and driver DS. sample GPU job scheduled and completed. logs look clean.

raj_sre: doing the chaos test now. deleting one worker node...

raj_sre: autoscaler spun up a replacement within ~3m, pods rescheduled, no QoS violations observed.

anna_ops: handoff complete for us-west-2. doc link: https://git.internal.redwood/runbooks/k8s/us-west-2-bootstrap (will push PR with full values).

mike_infra: leaving a note: follow-up actions for next week: request APAC GPU quota, run simulated traffic for 10k qps to measure autoscaler thresholds, add node taints for preemptible nodes.

sara_gpu: tagging GPU image versions in the runbook so we can reproduce driver/kernel combos.

anna_ops: thanks team :team: — wrapping. ping me if you want the runbook PR early review.

mike_infra: thanks! :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: pipeline infra/bootstrap/1764004321 completed successfully :white_check_mark:
